apiAgents.description: Manage separate credentials for server ingestion and read-only Agent access. Keys cannot be used interchangeably.
apiAgents.ingestionHint: Server OTLP, JSON and ES Bulk writes only. Cannot read data.
apiAgents.agentHint: Read-only MCP access. Only share with trusted Agents; telemetry may contain sensitive content.
apiAgents.name: Name
apiAgents.rotateConfirm: The old key stops working immediately. Update your clients.
apiAgents.changeConfirm: This takes effect immediately and may interrupt clients.
apiAgents.failed: Could not load or manage credentials

apiAgents.legacyHint: Reset this legacy key before viewing
apiAgents.secretHint: Administrators only. Closing clears the displayed secret; you can view it again later. Do not screenshot or share.
apiAgents.tools: 26 read-only tools for discovery, structured queries and automated analysis. No arbitrary SQL, raw sensitive attributes or writes. Default 15m; maximum 24h per window, 200 rows/groups and 2000 points/20 series. Results may truncate.

groupHints.discovery: Logical sources, actual hot tables, field types, units, correlations and hot/cold organization. Hot tables do not enumerate all history.
groupHints.query: Safe field filters, groups, time buckets, quantiles and equal-window comparison. Statistical facts, not inferred root causes.
groupHints.observability: Log trends, span/trace counts and observed parent-child service edges. Trace results may be incomplete.
groupHints.metrics: Safe label discovery, filters and split series. Default averages across labels; no counter rates.
groupHints.iot: Discover devices/signals from telemetry; query numeric trends and quality codes. No device credentials.
groupHints.rum: Project-filtered page reports, sessions, Vitals and errors. Sessions are not users. No replay or raw payload.

apiAgents.workflow: Suggested AI workflow: list_data_sources → get_data_organization → list_tables / describe_table → get_field_values, then query_data / aggregate_data / compare_periods and drill down. Unknown cold-layer completeness is never presented as complete.

settings.duckDbHint: Applies immediately and persists across restarts. This is not a limit on total process memory. Leave headroom for the host or container, ingest buffers and other components. Lowering this limit may not immediately reduce process memory.
settings.duckDbUnits: For example 512MB, 2GB or 1.5GiB. MB/GB use decimal units; MiB/GiB use binary units.

settings.ingestHint: Create ingest API keys in API & Agents
settings.adminOnly: Settings management is visible to super admins only
settings.s3SecretKeepHint: Secret configured: leave empty or keep the mask to reuse the stored value
settings.s3Hint: Changes apply after saving. With S3 enabled, archives go to the bucket; without S3, archives can still use local data/cold/. A successful connection test does not prove business data has been archived.
settings.archiveHint: Set local days before moving each data type to S3. With 1 day, yesterday and older complete UTC day tables are archived after UTC midnight. Scans run every 10 minutes; hot tables are removed after upload and validation. Local days=0 uses legacy settings, not immediate archiving. Manage cold days in Data Retention; types with cold days=0 are not archived.
settings.retentionS3Hint: S3 is enabled: only cold days are edited here. Manage local days before archiving on the S3 tab. Cold days are not the total lifetime: cold data expires at data date + local days + cold days (hourly cleanup). Cold=0 stops archiving that type and deletes expired hot data; it does not mean permanent cold retention. Sessions shares one policy for pageviews, events and replay.
settings.retentionHint: S3 is disabled: cold archives use local data/cold/. Data moves to cold storage after the local retention window; cold data expires at data date + local days + cold days. Cold=0 disables archiving and deletes expired hot data. Local days=0 uses legacy settings, not immediate archiving. Sessions shares one policy for pageviews, events and replay.
settings.compressionHint: Choose how cold-archive Parquet files are compressed.
settings.compressionScope: Only applies to cold-archive Parquet files in S3 or local data/cold/.
settings.compressionExclusions: Does not compress the DuckDB database file or affect SQLite metadata.
settings.compressionTiming: The new codec applies on the next archive round (within about 10 minutes), without a restart.
settings.compressionExisting: Existing archives are not recompressed; data with archiving disabled is unaffected.
